acceptances.justification: The pinned DHI images predate the fixed Debian package and no rebuilt DHI image containing the fix is currently available.
acceptances.impact: A crafted XML document could consume excessive CPU and deny service if it reached an Expat parsing path.
acceptances.exploitability: The application accepts signed Discord JSON and has no code path that parses user-controlled XML; the container is also non-root with a read-only root filesystem.
acceptances.evidence: Canonical ARM64 SBOM and Grype results identify libexpat1 2.8.2-1~deb13u1+dhi0, while repository inspection finds no application XML parser usage.
acceptances.reevaluation_conditions: Reevaluate when DHI publishes a rebuilt base image, Expat is introduced into an input path, or the container exposure changes.
